title: Number Chain
description: Connect numbers in the correct ascending sequence as fast as you can! Test your reflexes and number memory.
how_to_play:
1. Press Play to start the game.
2. Numbers will appear randomly on the screen.
3. Click or press the action key (SPACE / joystick button) on the numbers in ascending order.
4. Completing a chain gives points and increases the difficulty.
5. Try to get the highest score before time runs out!

Tips:
- Focus on the smallest numbers first.
- Speed is key, but mistakes will cost points.
- Chains increase your multiplier for bigger scores!
